text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a gain felt satisfying, but I should base future decisions on risk and expected return—not on locking in gains or avoiding realized losses.","A stock’s average cost is not a reason by itself to hold or sell; I should assess each position on its merits and keep diversification in view.","These few months of random price moves do not reveal what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term account swings or treating past prices as forecasts."]}
